verdict.rationale: Docs mention that enabling HIPAA compliance mode lets orgs 'control how call recordings and logs are stored,' implying some data retention control, but there's no explicit per-call recording on/off toggle, consent-disclosure feature, or configurable retention period documented. Missing for 10: explicit per-call recording enable/disable API, built-in consent disclosure/announcement feature, and configurable retention policy independent of HIPAA mode.
